name: literal-presence-inputs

files.main.c:
#if __has_include("marker.h")
#define LOCAL 1
#else
#define LOCAL 0
#endif
#if __has_include(<ordered.h>)
#define ORDERED 2
#else
#define ORDERED 0
#endif
#if __has_include("alias.h")
#define ALIASED 4
#else
#define ALIASED 0
#endif
#if __has_include("marker.h") && __has_include(<ordered.h>)
#define BOTH 8
#else
#define BOTH 0
#endif
int value(void);
int main(void) { return value() + LOCAL + ORDERED + ALIASED + BOTH; }

build_ninja:
rule cc
  command = cc -O2 -g0 -frandom-seed=0 -fdiagnostics-color=never -I../source/early -I../source/late -MD -MF $out.d -o $out -c $in
  depfile = $out.d
  deps = gcc
rule link
  command = cc -frandom-seed=0 $in -o $out
build main.o: cc ../source/main.c
build lib.o: cc ../source/lib.c
build app: link main.o lib.o
